Your privacy: everything you type or upload stays in your own browser and is cleared when you close this tab. It is never shared with anyone else, and it reaches our server only if you sign in and choose 'Save to my account'. Each visitor starts from a blank form. When you use the AI reader or “Suggest HS codes”, only the invoice text is sent to the AI service to process your request. Figures here are an approximate estimate — cross-check the final classification, duty, VAT and other levies with the Department of Customs or a licensed clearing agent before use.
